name: Granules India Ltd
title: Granules India Ltd-$ - 532482 - Transcript Of The Earnings Conference Call For Q4 And Financial Year Ended On March 31, 2026.

read.thesis: Granules FY26 revenue INR53,656m (+20%) and Q4 gross margin 65.7%, but management withdrew gross-margin guidance and flagged raw-material and freight inflation with no committed price increases yet.

utilisation.quote: the utilization in the Q4 was at a healthy level

capex.quote: So next year, the capex will be broad-based. There is a new API facility, which we are doing.

triggers.label: No price increases yet despite input inflation
triggers.quote: there were no price increases we wish we had, whereas raw material prices have gone up and are still going up

triggers.label: Gross margin guidance withdrawn
triggers.quote: we are taking a step back and not committing to anything

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~INR600 crore, broad-based
triggers.quote: we are talking about in the similar range of INR600-odd crores in the upcoming year

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +23% YoY, sixth straight sequential rise
triggers.quote: Revenue for the quarter was INR14,706 million, up 23% year -on-year and 6% sequentially

triggers.label: Working capital to rise, net debt flat to up
triggers.quote: So there will be a small increase -- very small increase in the net debt

guidance.quote: we are taking a step back and not committing to anything
FY '27 onwards, it should be substantially lower
our focus is to deliver a PAT positive performance on an annual basis
we would want to maintain our working capital to sales ratio of 33% range
There can be a flattish net debt or a slight increase

red_flags.label: US FDA warning letter unresolved at Gagillapur; no reinspection timeline
red_flags.quote: I don't think we can estimate when they would walk in

red_flags.label: Peptide CDMO losses and project-driven lumpiness
red_flags.quote: Individual quarters may vary, depending on customer milestone and shipment timing

red_flags.label: Working capital build and cash conversion fell
red_flags.quote: Cash conversion was moderated due to planned working capital buildup

evasions.quote: It is a little uncertain in terms of giving margins clarity in terms of percentage
we can't read the FDA's mind, right?

evasions.topic: Senn order book and revenue split
evasions.quote: We can't disclose those kind of information.
we obviously cannot share the quota details
